title: Swing Arm Towel Rail, Double Arm, 12.5-Inch, Solid Brass | Assorted Wall Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more towel space without cluttering the wall? This double swing arm towel rail gives you two pivoting arms that swing out for use and fold in close to the wall when you’re done.

  • Save wall space in smaller bathrooms with two arms that swivel independently and tuck close to the wall
  • Keep towels separated and accessible thanks to a double-arm swing design that pivots for flexible placement
  • Maintain a clean, finished installation with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Choose a coordinated look as part of the Assorted Wall Accessories collection with multiple designer finish options available
  • Built for lasting use with solid brass construction

Specs & Installation

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 12.5 x 7.1 x 7 inches
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 12 x 12 inches
  • Shipping weight: 7 lbs
  • Mounting: wall-mounted with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Style: transitional

_previous.description: Designed with multi-use and modernity in mind, this space saving double arm towel bar is an ideal addition for your bathroom and/or kitchen. Each arm swivels independently and snuggles close to the wall when not in use - excellent to keep your bathroom and/or kitchen organized! Created with the finest solid brass materials Concealed screw mounting hardware installs easily Arms pivot for optimum flexibility and convenience Space saving for bathrooms with limited room Available in 15 designer finishes Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in.
